heading: JavaScript is switched off
sub: The web dashboard needs JavaScript to run. Here's what it offers, and how to use LAN Orangutan without it. Pick whichever you prefer.
webIntro: A live, visual view of your network. It uses JavaScript for:
webLive: Live device updates as the server scans
webScans: Running scans, and sorting, filtering, searching
webEditing: Editing labels and groups, and copying addresses
webAction: Allow JavaScript for this site (in your browser or script blocker), then reload.
cliIntro: Same discovery, no browser or JavaScript needed, straight from your terminal:
safetyAnswer: Yes. LAN Orangutan is self-hosted: its JavaScript runs entirely in your own browser against your own server, and makes no third-party or external calls. It is served from this machine at {path}.
